summary: All acceptance criteria are met. Independently re-ran the test suite (19/19 passing) and production build (exits 0, generates dist/), and read the actual App.jsx, calculator.js, App.css, and vite.config.js on disk (working tree is clean and matches HEAD). Arithmetic dispatch is correct for all four operations including negatives and decimals; division by zero (including -0 divisor and 0/0) returns the exact required string 'Cannot divide by zero'; zero-value results remain visible due to a strict `result !== null` check rather than truthiness; blank operands are rejected before implicit numeric coercion; editing any operand or the operation after a result/error clears stale output; overflow/non-finite results are caught and shown as a concise error instead of Infinity/NaN. Labels are correctly associated via htmlFor/id, and the form's native submit behavior satisfies Enter-key submission. CSS uses fluid/relative sizing (max-width container, grid `1fr` columns, box-sizing: border-box) with no fixed min-widths, which should avoid horizontal overflow at 320/768/1280px per the plan's responsive requirement. A few low-severity, non-blocking observations are listed below (scope-creep in the bonus keypad's missing decimal/negative support, a minor test-coverage gap for partial-blank operands, and one redundant condition) but none constitute a bug, missing requirement, or edge-case failure against the stated acceptance criteria.

issues.problem: The bonus keypad grid (digits 0-9, operators, C, =) has no decimal-point or negative-sign key, so a user relying only on the keypad cannot enter decimals or negative numbers even though the app overall supports them via the text inputs.
issues.required_change: Either add '.' and '+/-' keys to the keypad, or omit this optional feature since it was not requested by the plan/spec.

issues.problem: Only the fully-blank-operands case is covered by a component test; the partial-blank case (one operand filled, the other empty) is not asserted end-to-end.
issues.required_change: Add a test that fills only one operand, submits, and asserts the same validation error appears with no numeric result.

issues.problem: `if (b === 0 || Object.is(b, -0))` is redundant since `-0 === 0` is already true in JavaScript, making the Object.is check dead code.
issues.required_change: Simplify to `if (b === 0)` for clarity, or add a comment explaining why the extra check is intentionally kept.
